astro-power.name: Astro Power
astro-power.desc: Every Astro Power hero gets a damage boost. Whichever Astro Power hero is carrying the most equipment is crowned the Astro Sovereign and gets a much bigger boost plus Hybrid Lifesteal — so pile your gear onto one of them.

bruiser.name: Bruiser
bruiser.desc: Bruisers hit harder with basic attacks, and both their basic and enhanced basic attacks can strike a second time.

dauntless.name: Dauntless
dauntless.desc: Every ally starts the fight with a shield; Dauntless heroes get a much bigger one.

defender.name: Defender
defender.desc: Every ally gains Hybrid DEF; Defenders gain a larger share, and that extra is doubled for the first 20 seconds of the fight.

dragon-altar.name: Dragon Altar
dragon-altar.desc: Special tiles appear on the board. Any hero standing on one gains bonus Hybrid ATK and HP; Dragon Altar heroes get triple that bonus.

dragoncaller.name: Dragoncaller
dragoncaller.desc: Every 3 seconds a dragon strikes the 9-tile block holding the most enemies for True damage based on their Max HP, and each strike buffs your Dragoncallers' damage. Three strikes per battle.

echomancer.name: Echomancer
echomancer.desc: Each match summons a Chrono Wanderer — a past-season 5-Gold hero, randomly Moskov, X.Borg or Gatotkaca. Deployed heroes bank Echo Energy at the start and end of each battle; every point raises the Skill Damage and HP of all Echomancers and the Wanderer by 0.03%. The Wanderer enters the fight at 100 energy, and reaching 300 / 600 / 999 for the first time hands out stage rewards.

enchanted-tales.name: Enchanted Tales
enchanted-tales.desc: At the start of each match one random 4-Gold Enchanted Tales hero becomes the Protagonist with an enhanced skill. Killed enemies drop Tale Fragments — up to 3 a battle, 30 overall — and each collected Fragment permanently strengthens your Enchanted Tales heroes.

kishin.name: Kishin
kishin.desc: You get a piece of Kishin-only equipment and all Kishin heroes gain Hybrid DEF. Buying Kishin heroes again from the shop upgrades that gear — up to Arcane (Tier 3) through the shop, and all the way to Supreme (Tier 4) once 10 Kishin heroes are active. Each shop upgrade refills the slot with another hero.

mage.name: Mage
mage.desc: Every ally gains Magic ATK; Mages gain a much larger share.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.desc: Every ally gains attack speed; Marksmen gain a much larger share.

mistbender.name: Mistbender
mistbender.desc: Every skill a Mistbender casts drops Spirit Sand into the shop (up to 60 a round, 99 stored). Spend it in the Spirit Sand shop for extra items.

phasewarper.name: Phasewarper
phasewarper.desc: Phasewarpers deal bonus damage, and the first time one drops below 40% HP it blinks to a safe tile and heals.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: At the start of every round each Scavenger hands you a free hero from the shop.

shadeweaver.name: Shadeweaver
shadeweaver.desc: At the start of battle a gust tears down every column that holds a Shadeweaver hero, starting from the back tile — it speeds up allies in the lane and knocks any enemies it passes into the air.

spectre.name: SPECTRE
spectre.desc: The first time you two-star a SPECTRE hero, the game gifts you a higher-cost SPECTRE hero. All SPECTRE heroes deal bonus damage, and the chain eventually unlocks Alpha, the game's first 7-Gold hero.

starbelle.name: Starbelle
starbelle.desc: You're handed a Lightstick item; whoever holds it becomes the Fan. When battle starts the Fan and all Starbelles gain Hybrid DEF, and the Fan cheers — passing a Hybrid ATK bonus to the Starbelles and to itself that scales with how many Starbelles are on the board.

stargazer.name: Stargazer
stargazer.desc: Every ally regenerates mana each second; Stargazers regenerate a lot more.

swiftblade.name: Swiftblade
swiftblade.desc: Every ally gains Hybrid Penetration; Swiftblade heroes gain much more.

weapon-master.name: Weapon Master
weapon-master.desc: Every ally gains Hybrid Lifesteal; Weapon Masters gain extra Lifesteal and a large Physical ATK boost.
